cover_headline: DeSantis Blames Midterm Rout on GOP Failure to 'Shut Off H-1B Visas'

end.headline: DeSantis Blames Midterm Rout on GOP Failure to 'Shut Off H-1B Visas'
end.line: A Democratic Congress makes near-term legislation against H-1B highly unlikely — the programme enters 2027 unchanged by this week's politics.

facts: India-born workers received 70 per cent of the roughly 406,000 H-1B petitions approved in fiscal 2025, according to the USCIS annual report to Congress
Republicans lost control of both the House and the Senate in the November 3 elections, with Democrats set to control Congress from January
No immigration rule changed this week: H-1B petitions continue under the existing USCIS rules, including the $100,000 payment that applies to certain new petitions

quote.speaker: Ron DeSantis
quote.text: Why haven't we done immigration, shut off H-1B visas? Why haven't we codified Trump's immigration executive orders?
